derived_from.rows: every row with a non-empty Gene after each sheet's 'Gene' header (335 rows, 334 genes); values copied verbatim (stripped); the MutSig genes and OncoKB-CNA sheets are not used

copy_number_rule: A gene is a copy-number driver from this source when the paper lists it as a recurrent GISTIC target in a direction consistent with its role: OG with a non-empty 'GISTIC amp', TSG with a non-empty 'GISTIC del', any other label (NA, Unknown, blank) with either. Pathway membership alone is not a copy-number claim.
citation: Sanchez-Vega F, Mina M, Armenia J, et al. Oncogenic Signaling Pathways in The Cancer Genome Atlas. Cell. 2018;173(2):321-337.e10. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2018.03.035. PMID 29625050. Table S3: Curated pathway templates.
licence: No explicit data licence: publisher supplementary material (TCGA PanCanAtlas), used here as a factual gene/role list with attribution, as for the Bailey list. Replaceable by OncoKB labels through the copy-number driver-source interface.
